Our Proud Alumni

About ROSA

Rio Tinto Zhombe High School Old Students Association is a voluntary organisation formed in 2012 by former students who share a common past and heritage. By coming together, members support each other and contribute meaningfully to the development and progress of Rio Tinto Zhombe High School.

Article 1 – Name

The association is known as Rio Tinto Old Students Association (ROSA).

Article 3 – Policies

The Association shall be non-political, non-sectarian and non-profit making.

Aims & Objectives

  • ✔ Bring past students together to deliberate on matters concerning membership and the school.
  • ✔ Engage authorities for the progress of the school and mutual benefit of members.
  • ✔ Unite both past and present students.
  • ✔ Promote sustained interest in the school.
  • ✔ Encourage selfless love among members and their Alma Mater.
  • ✔ Formulate plans for the progress of students and the school.
  • ✔ Assist needy students through books and financial support.

Membership

Full Membership

Open to all past students of sound mind committed to ROSA objectives.

Associate

Past tutors who served meritoriously, subject to AGM recommendation.

Honorary

Individuals or institutions contributing significantly to the school.

Student

Past students currently in tertiary education awaiting full membership.
